question: What was Neeraj Chopra’s final position at the 2025 Doha Diamond League javelin event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Second**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**, India's celebrated javelin thrower, competed in the **2025 Doha Diamond League** javelin event and secured the **second position**.
 
• The Doha Diamond League is part of the prestigious **Diamond League series**, organized annually by **World Athletics**, bringing together elite athletes from around the globe.
 
• Neeraj Chopra's performance in the event highlighted his consistent ability to compete against the world's best, maintaining his stronghold as one of the premier javelin throwers globally.
 
• His throw at the event fell just short of the winning mark, but his result reinforced his status as a top contender in the lead-up to other major events, such as the **World Championships** and the **Olympics**.
 
• The 2025 Doha Diamond League saw fierce competition, with top javelin throwers such as **Johannes Vetter** and **Anderson Peters** also participating, making Chopra's silver medal even more commendable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Achievements:**

 
 
• Neeraj Chopra won the **gold medal** in the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**, becoming the first Indian to win an Olympic medal in athletics.
 
• He has also won medals in major events such as the **World Athletics Championships**, **Asian Games**, and **Commonwealth Games**.
 
• He holds the Indian national record for the javelin throw with a distance of **89.94 meters**, achieved in **2022**.
 
 
 
• **Doha Diamond League:**
 
 
• The Doha Diamond League is one of the annual events in the **Diamond League series**, which serves as a platform for world-class athletes to compete in track and field events.
 
• Held in Doha, Qatar, this event is known for its state-of-the-art facilities and attracts some of the biggest names in athletics.
 
• The 2025 edition featured intense competition in various disciplines, including the javelin throw.
 
 
 
• **Javelin Throw:**
 
 
• The javelin throw is a track and field event where athletes throw a spear-like implement as far as possible.
 
• The men's javelin must weigh **800 grams** and be **2.6 to 2.7 meters** long, as per **World Athletics regulations**.
 
• Key factors influencing performance include technique, strength, and optimal release angle (around **35-40 degrees**).
 
 
 
• **Competitors:**
 
 
• **Johannes Vetter**: A German javelin thrower and one of the leading athletes in the discipline, with a personal best of **97.76 meters**.
 
• **Anderson Peters**: A Grenadian thrower and two-time **World Champion** known for his consistency in major competitions.
